content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: NIT Delhi has announced a total of 10 vacancies for various Project Positions through a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these positions is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for NIT Delhi Project Positions?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for NIT Delhi Project Positions is scheduled to be held on 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Positions?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications include B. Tech. (Electrical/ Mechanical), B. Tech. (Civil), Diploma or Equivalent or Above (Electrical/Mechanical), Diploma or Equivalent or Above (Civil), B. Tech. or Equivalent or Above (Civil), and 10th Pass (Desirable).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Project Positions?
faq.answer: The salary varies for different posts, with Sr. Project Technical Assistant receiving 42600, Junior Project Technical Assistant receiving 32800, and Project Attendant receiving 20160. Project Engineer will receive honorarium as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at National Institute of Technology Delhi. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
